text:
Augustus III most likely bought Correggio's *Magdalen in the Desert* (the *Penitent Magdalen*) in 1746. That agrees with the team note, but I haven't checked it against a source. His 1745–46 Modena purchases for Dresden also included the *Madonna of Saint George*, which is what I said earlier. I can't tell the two apart from memory, so I'm switching to the note's answer only tentatively.

CONFIDENCE: 45
